A typed map of mathematical transformations across eight domains, with its fill layer, audit, receipts, formal links and Lean project.
dirs.audit: The audit: the fixed random sample, its field-by-field grades, and the targeted grades.
dirs.audit/blind: The blind second reading of the Mathlib match grades: the packet, the answer key, and each reader's grades.
dirs.catalogue: The paper catalogue: every paper the map cites and how deeply it has been read.
dirs.catalogue/imports: Paper lists imported from sibling repositories, bibliographic fields and reading status only.
dirs.domains: The map, readable, one file per domain (generated by scripts/build.mjs).
dirs.excerpts: Verbatim windows that receipt claims, each with its source URL and the hash of the source as fetched.
dirs.generation: Generation rounds: what was commissioned, what generators returned (landed verbatim and hashed), and how it was graded.
dirs.generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-001: The MM-DR-001 round: D9 operations and effect invariants from three generators, graded.
dirs.generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-002: The MM-DR-002 round: D9 bound to Android at android-16.0.0_r4 by three generators, graded against the tagged source.
dirs.generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-003: The MM-DR-003 round: prior art for D9 and its Android binding from two generators, graded against the cited repositories.
dirs.lean: A Lean 4 project on the pinned Mathlib that states and proves claims Mathlib does not cover.
dirs.lean/MathMap: The Lean sources, one file per topic, each naming the entries it bears on.
dirs.mapfill: The fill layer the parser applies over the landed map: clone resolution, fills, additions, conditions, corrections, invariants and formal links.
dirs.prompts: Research prompts sent out to generate candidate content; returned reports are leads, verified before anything lands.
dirs.reports: Generated reports on data quality, error rates, the catalogue and the formal queue.
dirs.scripts: The parser, query tool, checks, build and tool server. Node, no dependencies.
dirs.source: The map as landed, verbatim, and the report its D7 names come from.
dirs.docs: Notes about the map that are neither data nor generated.
dirs.docs/inbound: Dated proposals from other repositories and sessions, to verify and then fold in or decline.
dirs.generation/2026-10-11-ro-bp-001: The RO-BP-001 round: two D9 operations for journal-native systems, written for the Research_OS blueprint, graded and ruled.
dirs.generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-004: The MM-DR-004 round: D9 bound to NixOS at nixpkgs 7c8764b, and the desktop vocabulary measurement, graded against the pinned source.
dirs.generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-004/part-b: The three graders' claim tables for Part B, every fact cited by path and line at the pins; model output, sampled and re-read in grading-part-b.md.
dirs.generation/2026-10-11-gen-001: The GEN-001 round: the first test of gap-driven generation, its candidates and composites, graded.
dirs.generation/2026-10-11-deform-001: The DEFORM-001 round: sublation read as Lie algebra deformation; the kinematical calibration and the Poincare-Heisenberg seed, computed exactly and graded.
dirs.generation/2026-10-12-select-002: The SELECT-002 round: the mixing form F5 tested with decoys on every menu, and iterated menus following the lowest-order path under conflicts in order, pre-registered.
dirs.generation/2026-10-12-select-001: The SELECT-001 round: whether the conflicts of physics select the historical successor from menus large enough to fail, pre-registered.
dirs.generation/2026-10-11-history-001: The HISTORY-001 round: whether the deformation generator retrodicts paradigm transitions, pre-registered, with null controls and a time-sliced vocabulary.

docs.CLAUDE.md: Standing instructions for agents: the checks, the layout, and the rules for origins, receipts, flags, rounds and bindings; imports the kit's shared conventions.
docs.AGENTS.md: Points agents other than Claude Code to CLAUDE.md and the files it imports.
docs.generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-004/grading-: The line-by-line grading of Part B, the Nix operations: claim counts, sampled citations re-read, what changed, the four invariants, and a held finding about Nix.
docs.generation/2026-10-11-mm-dr-004/part-b/g: Claims of D9-NIX-C01 to C03 (realize, fetch, pure evaluation), graded, with corrected entries.
Claims of D9-NIX-C04 to C06 (impure evaluation, flake pin, overlay), graded, with corrected entries.
Claims of D9-NIX-C07 to C09 (switch, rollback, garbage collection), graded, with corrected entries and the split into C10.
docs..github/workflows/check.yml: CI: runs scripts/check-all.mjs, and builds the Lean project and verifies its audit.
docs.LICENSE: CC BY 4.0 for the data, MIT for the scripts.
docs.MANIFEST.json: The source commit and the hash of every generated file (generated).
docs.README.md: What the map is, its origins, tiers, evidence levels and layout (generated by scripts/build.mjs).
docs.SHA256SUMS: The generated files' hashes in sha256sum form (generated).
docs.audit.json: The audit grades with their quotes and sources, machine-readable (generated).
docs.audit/blind/key-0_1.json: The item ids of the blind packet, for a reader's answers.
docs.audit/blind/packet-0_1.md: The blind packet: each Mathlib link's claim and quoted Lean statement, without the grade.
docs.audit/sample-0_1.json: The fixed stratified sample of 60 entries, drawn before grading.
docs.catalogue/papers.json: The paper catalogue's source: ids, entries cited, reading status and excerpts.
docs.infra.json: Configuration of the vendored Repo-Infrastructure kit: which checks run.
docs.infra.lock.json: Pins the vendored kit in .infra/: upstream commit and the hash of every file.
docs.lean/.gitignore: Keeps Lake's build directory out of git.
docs.lean/AUDIT.json: Each registered declaration's axioms, status (proved or stated) and dependencies, regenerated by scripts/lean.mjs --audit.
docs.lean/MathMap.lean: The library root; imports every MathMap module.
docs.lean/MathMap/Cone.lean: The cone on a space as a quotient, contractible when the space is nonempty (D4-075).
docs.lean/MathMap/HTransform.lean: The Doob h-transform of Brownian motion with h(x) = x, giving the Bessel-3 generator (D5-037).
docs.lean/MathMap/LawvereTierney.lean: Lawvere-Tierney topologies, read in the truth values (D7-288).
docs.lean/MathMap/Meta.lean: Audit support: the #mathmap_deps command that lists the MathMap definitions a statement depends on.
docs.lean/MathMap/OpenGames.lean: Open games and their monoidal product (D7-X04).
docs.lean/MathMap/SubtoposColimits.lean: The inclusion of a subtopos need not preserve colimits (D7-X02).
docs.lean/MathMap/Topos.lean: Subtoposes, essential geometric morphisms and levels.
docs.lean/WISHLIST.md: What the map's claims need from Mathlib and do not find there, ordered by the links each would unlock.
docs.lean/lake-manifest.json: Lake's pinned dependencies (Mathlib at the map's pinned commit).
docs.mapfill/README.md: What the fill layer is, what it corrects in the landed map, and how fills are graded.
docs.reports/AUDIT.md: Audit error rates by stratum and field, with every grade's receipt (generated by scripts/audit.mjs).
docs.reports/FORMAL-QUEUE.md: Unreviewed name matches against Mathlib, still to be read (generated by scripts/formal.mjs).
docs.reports/MATHMAP.md: Data quality of the parsed and filled map (generated by scripts/mathmap.mjs).
docs.reports/SECOND-READING.md: The blind second reading compared with the map's grades (generated by scripts/blind.mjs).
docs.source/Category_Theory_Transformation_En: The D7 mapper report the D7 names come from.
docs.source/math_map.md: The map as landed, verbatim; never edited.
docs.reports/TOPOLOGY.md: The topology of the typed map: pieces, loops, ends, parallel routes and their disagreements (generated by scripts/topology.mjs).
docs.reports/TYPING.md: How much of the map a word list types for free, by domain and kind, with the untyped words that remain (generated by scripts/type-lexicon.mjs).
docs.reports/GAPS.md: The typed map's gaps: kinds nothing produces or consumes, and kinds no chain reaches (generated by scripts/gaps.mjs).

families.domains/D*.md: One domain of the map, readable (generated by scripts/build.mjs).
families.excerpts/mathlib-*.txt: Mathlib declaration statements at the pinned commit, quoted verbatim, with each file's hash.
families.excerpts/wikipedia-*.txt: Verbatim windows from a Wikipedia page at a pinned revision (CC BY-SA).
families.excerpts/nlab-*.txt: Verbatim windows from an nLab page.
families.excerpts/nixpkgs-*.txt: Verbatim windows from a nixpkgs source file at a pinned commit (MIT), with the file's hash.
families.excerpts/pos-*.txt: Verbatim windows from a Proceedings of Science paper.
families.excerpts/arxiv-*.txt: Verbatim windows from an arXiv paper.
families.excerpts/econometrica-*.txt: Verbatim windows from a journal article.
families.audit/blind/reader-*.json: One reader's blind grades, with a statement of the reader's independence.
families.prompts/MM-DR-*.md: One research prompt (MM-DR-NNN), in the shape of the PH-DR prompts in A-Viable-Fork/phone, with Scaffold Update Notes stripped before sending.
families.generation/2026-10-11-deform-001/calibra: The calibration round's computed report: H^2, directions, integration and contraction of the kinematical algebras (generated by scripts/deform.mjs --round calibration).
families.generation/2026-10-11-deform-001/seed.md: The seed round's computed report: the deformations of Poincare semidirect Heisenberg and their real forms (generated by scripts/deform.mjs --round seed).
families.generation/2026-10-12-select-002/rows.md: SELECT-002's computed report: the F5 rows with decoys, the iterated paths, and the boosts-only deviation (generated by scripts/deform-select2.mjs --round --deviation).
SELECT-001's computed report: every stage's menu, survivors, decoys and grade, and the post-hoc mixing diagnostic (generated by scripts/deform-select.mjs --round --explore).
families.generation/2026-10-11-history-001/rows.m: HISTORY-001's computed report: every row's candidates, survivors, controls, time slice and grade (generated by scripts/deform-history.mjs --round).
families.generation/*/preregistration.md: A round's pre-registration: rows, constraints, controls and verdict rules, committed alone before any computation.
families.generation/*/record.md: A generation record (kit template): the commission, seeds, candidates and handoff; expression, not evidence.
families.generation/*/grading.md: The grading of one generation round: each candidate checked against sources and code, with evidence marks and verdicts.
families.generation/*/report-*.md: One generator's report for the round, landed verbatim; its hash is in the round's record.
families.generation/*/package-*.zip: A generator's companion package, landed verbatim; its hash is in the round's record.
families.generation/*/bindings-*.json: A generator's platform bindings for the round, landed verbatim; its hash is in the round's record.
families.generation/*/receipts-*.json: A generator's source receipts (paths and hashes at a tag), landed verbatim; its hash is in the round's record.
families.generation/*/trial-*.md: A trial run of an external tool on the round's output: the harness inline, the commit it ran at, and what it returned.
families.generation/*/*.patch: A draft patch to an external tool, written and tested here; held until the operator signs off on sending it upstream.
families.docs/inbound/*.md: A dated proposal from another repository or session; a lead, not a change.
